title: Anton and Chess
statementMd:
Anton likes to play chess. Also, he likes to do programming. That is why he decided to write the program that plays chess. However, he finds the game on $8$ to $8$ board to too simple, he uses an infinite one instead.

The first task he faced is to check whether the king is in check. Anton doesn't know how to implement this so he asks you to help.

Consider that an infinite chess board contains one white king and the number of black pieces. There are only rooks, bishops and queens, as the other pieces are not supported yet. The white king is said to be in check if at least one black piece can reach the cell with the king in one move.

Help Anton and write the program that for the given position determines whether the white king is in check.

Remainder, on how do chess pieces move:

- Bishop moves any number of cells diagonally, but it can't "leap" over the occupied cells.
- Rook moves any number of cells horizontally or vertically, but it also can't "leap" over the occupied cells.
- Queen is able to move any number of cells horizontally, vertically or diagonally, but it also can't "leap".

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 500 000$) — the number of black pieces.

The second line contains two integers $*x*_{0}$ and $*y*_{0}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{0}, *y*_{0} ≤ 10^{9}$) — coordinates of the white king.

Then follow $*n*$ lines, each of them contains a character and two integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — type of the $*i*$-th piece and its position. Character '`B`' stands for the bishop, '`R`' for the rook and '`Q`' for the queen. It's guaranteed that no two pieces occupy the same position.

## Output

The only line of the output should contains "`YES`" (without quotes) if the white king is in check and "`NO`" (without quotes) otherwise.

## Note

Picture for the first sample:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93d849830ccab945077eb5a518b26b0b4f419e0.png)

White king is in check, because the black bishop can reach the cell with the white king in one move. The answer is "

YES

".

Picture for the second sample:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6d8e343cc54e912524bf3214dd50aacfbf85ede2.png)

Here bishop can't reach the cell with the white king, because his path is blocked by the rook, and the bishop cant "leap" over it. Rook can't reach the white king, because it can't move diagonally. Hence, the king is not in check and the answer is "

NO

".
statementZhMd:
安东喜欢下国际象棋。同时，他也喜欢编程。因此，他决定编写一个下棋程序。不过，他觉得在 $8$ to $8$ 棋盘上的游戏过于简单，于是使用了一个无限大的棋盘。

他遇到的第一个任务是判断王是否被将军。安东不知道该如何实现，所以请你帮助他。

假设一个无限大的国际象棋棋盘上有一个白王和若干个黑方棋子。黑方棋子只有车、象和后，因为其他棋子暂时还不支持。如果至少有一个黑方棋子可以在一步之内到达白王所在的格子，则称白王被将军。

请帮助安东编写程序，根据给定的局面判断白王是否被将军。

下面是关于棋子移动方式的补充说明：

- 象可以沿对角线移动任意格，但不能“跳过”被占据的格子。
- 车可以沿水平方向或垂直方向移动任意格，但同样不能“跳过”被占据的格子。
- 后可以沿水平方向、垂直方向或对角线移动任意格，但同样不能“跳过”被占据的格子。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 500 000$）——黑方棋子的数量。

第二行包含两个整数 $*x*_{0}$ 和 $*y*_{0}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{0}, *y*_{0} ≤ 10^{9}$）——白王的坐标。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一个字符和两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $i$ 个棋子的类型及其位置。字符 '`B`' 表示象，'`R`' 表示车，'`Q`' 表示后。保证没有两个棋子占据同一个位置。

## 输出格式

输出一行：如果白王被将军，输出 "`YES`"（不含引号）；否则输出 "`NO`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

第一个样例的图片：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93d849830ccab945077eb5a518b26b0b4f419e0.png)

白王被将军，因为黑方的象可以在一步之内到达白王所在的格子。答案是 "

YES

"。

第二个样例的图片：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6d8e343cc54e912524bf3214dd50aacfbf85ede2.png)

这里象无法到达白王所在的格子，因为它的路径被车阻挡，而象不能跳过车。车也无法到达白王所在的格子，因为车不能沿对角线移动。因此，白王没有被将军，答案是 "

NO

"。
